capabilities: Sync the vault with a remote git repository over HTTPS on desktop and mobile
Resolve conflicting edits by pushing a sync-conflict branch and opening a pull or merge request
Set per-plugin distribution policy for sharing or keeping community plugin files and settings local
Show the latest commit that changed the active note in a sidebar panel
Decrypt and re-encrypt git-crypt-protected paths during sync using imported keys
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manual release download. README discloses that the plugin was built with AI assistance (Claude). HTTPS only — SSH is unsupported; no submodules, LFS or rebase; shallow clones by default and large vaults can hit mobile memory limits. Tokens fall back to plain-text data.json where OS keychain storage is unavailable, with a settings warning.
intentEvidence: Halyard Sync differs by compiling libgit2 to WebAssembly for real mobile support, and by refusing to write conflict markers into notes.
problem: Existing git-in-Obsidian workflows need a native git binary, which mobile devices cannot provide, and typical merges write conflict markers into notes.

requires.name: git hosting account (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea/Forgejo, Azure DevOps or other HTTPS host)

summary: Git-based vault sync over HTTPS to GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea/Forgejo, Azure DevOps or any host, using bundled libgit2-WASM on desktop and mobile.
